subject: reference-stencil3d

created_trees.objective: Partir de T2, le candidat mesuré le plus rapide, et intégrer son `omp simd` sur les lignes x à la décomposition statique des lignes de T1. Préserver les barrières entre pas, les deux tampons et le budget `threads`, sans importer T3 ni modifier les options de compilation. Vérifier la correction puis comparer aux sources avec le protocole officiel, à 1 et 4 cœurs.
created_trees.stop_condition: Ne retenir l’intégration que si elle est valide et améliore de façon répétée T2 dans des mesures compatibles; sinon conserver T2 comme meilleur candidat. Une confirmation indépendante de G restera nécessaire.
created_trees.subject: Combinaison du SIMD par ligne et du parallélisme OpenMP

active_architecture.warning: Model wall times overlap research; do not add them to campaign wall time

children.objective: In `src/candidate.cpp`, compare the serial baseline with static row-level OpenMP work sharing using both a parallel region per timestep and one persistent region across all six timesteps. Honor the `threads` budget without relying on global OpenMP state; retain a low-overhead serial path where appropriate. Keep SIMD and temporal blocking out of scope. Verify the full output and boundary behavior on smaller checks and n=256; measure under the official one- and four-core settings so parallel-region overhead and scaling are distinguishable.
children.subject: OpenMP scaling and parallel-region overhead

children.objective: In `src/candidate.cpp`, isolate the unfused single-timestep kernel and contiguous-x line traversal. Compare the existing scalar formulation with compiler-vectorizable and, only if supported by the frozen build, explicit SIMD formulations; do not change compiler flags or assume an ISA extension. Account for the interior start offset despite aligned inputs. Keep threading and spatial/temporal blocking out of scope. Preserve numerical tolerance and boundaries; validate and measure the kernel under the official settings.
children.subject: Single-sweep x-line kernel vectorization

children.objective: In `src/candidate.cpp`, compare spatial blocking within one timestep against halo-correct fusion of multiple consecutive timesteps per tile. Account for the radius-3 expanding halo, the recurrence's dependence on both time levels, even/odd buffer parity, and untouched boundaries. Keep explicit SIMD and thread parallelization out of scope; include scratch allocation in timing. Preserve full output initialization and numerical tolerance, validate smaller checks and n=256, and record correct results even if a variant is slower, since it may inform a later combination.
children.subject: Spatial and temporal cache-blocking controls
